slo_title: Describe the importance of structured programming and the theorem

mcq.q: Which paradigm uses facts and rules to drive logic-based reasoning?
Which of the following is NOT a basic structure in structured programming (according to the structured programming theorem)?
The structured programming theorem states that any program can be built using which three constructs?
Which of the following best categorizes Python?
What is the main goal of structured programming?

options.A: a) To make code run faster
options.B: b) To simplify and organize code
options.D: d) To hide errors in code

mcq.answer_text: b) To simplify and organize code

sq.q: A language claims to support procedural, object-oriented, and functional paradigms. How would you structure an app to reflect this hierarchy?
answer: procedural logic is used for utility functions, OOP for data models , and functional programming for data transformations. This reflects increasing abstraction from low to high level.

sq.q: You are teaching a mixed-paradigm language. How would you explain the relationship between logic and functional paradigms?
answer: Both are declarative. Logic programming focuses on rules and inference (e.g., Prolog), while functional programming emphasizes mathematical function application and purity (e.g., Haskell).

lq.q: A technology startup is building a modular software platform intended to serve diverse clients, including e-commerce, education, and healthcare sectors. The architecture must support the following: Plug-in modules for business-specific logic Plug-in modules for business-specific logic Real-time transaction processing Real-time transaction processing Integration with rule-based compliance systems (e.g., health standards or tax policies) Integration with rule-based compliance systems (e.g., health standards or tax policies) Scalable data transformation pipelines Scalable data transformation pipelines The CTO proposes organizing the system using a hierarchy of paradigms, starting from procedural constructs, layered with object-oriented abstractions, and optionally integrating declarative logic where needed. Task: Analyze this proposal and respond to the following: Illustrate how programming paradigms can be organized hierarchically in a modern software architecture. Object-Oriented Layer : Manages core domain entities like Customer , Order , Inventory , encapsulating state and behavior. Declarative Layer : Encodes business rules using logic programming or SQL for dynamic compliance checks and data querying.
